title: Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act
evidence: Justice Laws consolidation: "[Enacted by section 186 of chapter 12 of the Statutes of Canada, 2018, in force on assent June 21, 2018.]" and "Assented to 2018-06-21" (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/G-11.55/20180621/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Part 1 is the fuel charge, Part 2 the industrial greenhouse gas emissions (output-based pricing) system, Part 3 provincial schemes. The Output-Based Pricing System Regulations are made under this Act (see ca-obps-regs). 24 dated versions are served, 2018-06-21 to 2026-03-26.
status_note: Read from the Justice Laws page of the version dated 2026-03-12: Part 1 Subdivision A and sections 17 to 22 (the charge on fuel) show "[Repealed, 2026, c. 2, s. 14]" from 2026-03-12; Parts 2 to 4 remain in the 2026-03-26 version. The page was not read for any earlier rate or order that set the charge to zero.

title: Output-Based Pricing System Regulations
evidence: Reg. s.93(1): "these Regulations are deemed to have come into force on January 1, 2019." Registration 2019-06-28 (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/SOR-2019-266/20190628/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Made under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act (ca-ggppa; the page heading names that Act). The first version Justice Laws serves starts at registration, 2019-06-28, so the earliest record is dated 2019-06-28 although the Regulations are deemed in force from 2019-01-01. 12 dated versions, 2019-06-28 to 2025-04-01. The 2019 register row described it as: annual emissions reports and compensation obligations for covered facilities.

title: Canadian Net-Zero Emissions Accountability Act
evidence: Justice Laws consolidation: "Assented to 2021-06-29"; the only commencement clause is s.29 "Section 23 comes into force on a day to be fixed by order of the Governor in Council", annotated "Section 23 in force March 31, 2023, see SI/2023-8" (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/C-19.3/20230331/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Duties fall on ministers (targets, plans, reports; s.23 on the Minister of Finance), not on companies. Two dated versions: 2021-06-29 and 2023-03-31 (s.23 in force).

title: Competition Act, section 74.01(1)(b.1) and (b.2) (environmental claims), added by S.C. 2024, c. 15
evidence: Justice Laws versions: the version "From 2023-12-15 to 2024-06-19" has s.74.01(1)(a), (b), (c) only; the version "From 2024-06-20 to 2024-12-14" (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/C-34/20240620/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02) adds (b.1) and (b.2), with the source note "2024, c. 15, s. 236". The page states no commencement sentence; the date is the version start. LEGISinfo was not opened.
notes: The record is the whole Act, because Justice Laws serves only whole-Act point-in-time pages; s.74.01 is at the marginal note "Misrepresentations to public". Stored from the first version containing (b.1) and (b.2): 2024-06-20, 2024-12-15, 2025-06-20, 2026-03-26 (four of the 26 versions the site serves; earlier versions do not contain the environmental-claims provisions).

title: Fighting Against Forced Labour and Child Labour in Supply Chains Act
evidence: s.28: "This Act comes into force on January 1 of the year following the year in which it receives royal assent." "Assented to 2023-05-11" (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/F-10.6/20240101/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Section 3 states the purpose: reporting obligations on entities; the Act also amends the Customs Tariff. Two dated versions: 2023-05-11 (assent, before commencement) and 2024-01-01.

title: Clean Fuel Regulations
evidence: Reg. s.176(1): "Subject to subsection (2), these Regulations come into force on the day on which they are registered." Registration 2022-06-21 (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/SOR-2022-140/20220621/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Made under CEPA 1999 (page heading); applies to primary suppliers of gasoline and diesel (s.4). It incorporates a standard by reference (s.2), whose text is not stored. Sections 173 and 175 come into force 2024-09-30. Two dated versions: 2022-06-21 and 2024-09-30.

title: Regulations Respecting Reduction in the Release of Methane and Certain Volatile Organic Compounds (Upstream Oil and Gas Sector)
evidence: Reg. s.58(1): "Subject to subsection (2), these Regulations come into force on January 1, 2020." s.58(2): sections 26, 27 and 37 to 41 come into force on January 1, 2023 (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-66/20180404/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Made under CEPA 1999. The first version Justice Laws serves starts at registration, 2018-04-04, so the earliest record is dated 2018-04-04 although the Regulations come into force on 2020-01-01. Four dated versions: 2018-04-04, 2020-01-01, 2023-01-01, 2025-12-12.

title: Canadian Greenhouse Gas Offset Credit System Regulations
evidence: Reg. s.50: "These Regulations come into force on the day on which they are registered." Registration 2022-05-20 (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/regulations/SOR-2022-111/20220520/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Made under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act (ca-ggppa; the page heading names that Act). One dated version: 2022-05-20.

title: Federal Sustainable Development Act
evidence: Justice Laws consolidation: "Assented to 2008-06-26"; the text has no commencement section (https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/F-8.6/20080626/P1TT3xt3.html, opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Duties fall on the federal government (strategy, progress reports), not on companies. Five dated versions: 2008-06-26, 2010-12-15, 2013-06-26, 2020-12-01, 2026-02-13.

title: Notice with respect to reporting of greenhouse gases (GHGs) for 2024 and 2025 (Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999, subsection 46(1))
citation: Canada Gazette, Part I, Vol. 157, No. 49, Supplement 1, 2023-12-09
evidence: Canada Gazette Part I Supplement 1 dated December 9, 2023: "Notice is hereby given, pursuant to subsection 46(1) of the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999 ... any person who operates a facility described in Schedule 3 to this notice during the 2024 and 2025 calendar years ... shall provide the Minister of the Environment with this information". No commencement clause; issue date taken per the lookup policy (opened 2026-11-02).
notes: Facility greenhouse gas reporting: 2024 data due 2025-06-02, 2025 data due 2026-06-01 (notice text). Amended by ca-cepa-s46-ghg-notice-amend-2025. The Gazette row is permission requested, so no text is stored.

title: OSFI Guideline B-15 Climate Risk Management
evidence: OSFI page opened 2026-11-02: "Publication type Guideline ... Date March 7, 2025 ... No B-15"; disclosure chapter: "The FRFI is expected to implement the expectations in Annexes 2-1 and 2-2 of this Guideline effective the fiscal periods ending on or after October 1, 2024, 2025 and 2026, as applicable." The page has no commencement clause for the Guideline as a whole; the issue date of the page's version is taken per the lookup policy.
notes: Supervisory guideline for federally regulated financial institutions (expectations, not an Act or regulation). The brief gave 2023 amended 2024; the page shows only March 7, 2025 (with a related "Letter to Industry - We are Updating Guideline B-15 for the Final CSSB Standards"), so the original 2023 issue date was not read from an official page.
